name: Cross Romance ~Koi to Mahjong to Hanafuda to~
original_name: クロス・ロマンス　恋と麻雀と花札と
source:
Cross Romance: Koi to Mahjong to Hanafuda to is a great mix of adventure, love, and a mahjong game. The player controls a high school student that seems to be like a mahjong hero of his town and he will meet different girls during the game that will try to defeat him. The goal of the game is to win the six days tournament that takes places in the town.

But between the different mahjong games the player can go around the town and talk to different girls. The game begins with a psychologic test and depending on the answers some girls will be more attracted to the player than others. Depending on the adventure part and the tournament result the story mode will have one ending out of the others.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPS-00713.html]PlayStation DataCenter[/url]]
translation:
《Cross Romance～恋与麻将与花札～》融合了冒险、恋爱与麻将玩法。玩家将扮演一名高中生，他似乎是镇上备受推崇的麻将高手。游戏中，他会遇见不同的女孩，她们都想在牌桌上打败他。玩家的目标是在镇上举办的六天赛事中夺冠。

在各场麻将比赛之间，玩家可以在镇上四处走动，与不同的女孩交谈。游戏以一项心理测试开场，回答会影响哪些女孩更容易对主角产生好感。故事模式最终迎来哪一种结局，则取决于冒险部分的发展与比赛结果。

[摘自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPS-00713.html]PlayStation DataCenter[/url]]
